description: List the account's pipelines (e.g. Sales Leads) with their statuses (StatusId, Name, IsActive) and optionally their custom fields. This is the setup, not the items — use lacrm_list_pipeline_items for those. LACRM: GetPipelines.

include_custom_fields.description: Include each pipeline's custom field definitions. Default here: false (they are verbose).

name: lacrm_list_pipelines
title: List pipelines
